g.text: Free institutions → conditional update → free redesign
G0a/G0b: IID design draws. Updated: fresh G0-weight forward. G1: free re-authoring.
T: throughput arm; E: efficiency arm. All attempts/ties retained; no extra merit veto.
A: accepted; Q: original-peer mean sum; R: review records. n/a is not zero.
Cross-score labels: 0a/0b/U/1. Development worlds, not held-out or causal benefit.
